hero.title: Your base for Prada, Monte Baldo & Lake Garda
hero.subtitle: A curated guide to the region — plus a private apartment for those we trust.
hero.body: We've been coming here for years. This site collects what we know: where to hike without the crowds, where to eat like a local, what to skip. The apartment is for family and close friends — not a rental.

hiking.title: Hiking
hiking.desc: Routes from easy lakeside walks to the Monte Baldo ridge, with honest notes on difficulty and crowds.

food.title: Food & wine
food.desc: Our favourite restaurants, agriturismi, and producers — chosen for quality, not for tourists.

experiences.title: Experiences
experiences.desc: Paragliding, sailing, olive oil tastings, local markets. What's worth it and what to skip.

wellness.title: Wellness
wellness.desc: Thermal baths, quiet spots, slow mornings. The lake has a particular quality of light in the early hours.

practical.title: Getting around
practical.desc: Ferries, buses, parking, the cable car. How to move without a car, and when you really need one.

family.title: With kids
family.desc: What works for families — beaches with shallow water, playgrounds, restaurants that genuinely welcome children.

honest.title: Honest notes about the region
items: July and August are the best months for swimming — but also the busiest. May, June, and September suit those who prefer fewer crowds over beach season.
Parking in Malcesine, Castelletto, and the larger lakeside towns is very difficult in summer. Arrive early or use park-and-ride options where available.
The Monte Baldo cable car has long queues on summer weekends. Book online in advance or arrive before 9 am.
The northern end of the lake is windier — perfect for sailing and windsurfing, less ideal for quiet swimming.
Many restaurants close on Mondays. Always check opening days before making plans.
The obvious tourist towns are beautiful but heavily commercial. The real character of the region is found inland and at altitude.

hikes.title: Hiking nearby
hikes.text:
Prada sits on the slopes of Monte Baldo — one of the best hiking areas on Lake Garda. Dozens of trails start right from the doorstep: easy walks through olive groves, ridge climbs with panoramic lake views, forest paths through chestnut woods.

The Komoot link below has a curated selection of routes within ~5 km of the apartment.

Best time is spring (April–June) and autumn (September–October). Summer can be hot, winter brings snow above 1500 m.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text:
The house has a large private parking area on the fenced property — park wherever you like, there is always plenty of space.

For trips to the lake: parking in Malcesine, Castelletto, and other lakeside towns is very difficult in summer. Arrive early in the morning or use park-and-ride options.
